personality_one_liner: Energetic, touchable, and highly legible campus mobility experience with chunky controls, floating panels, and an outdoor-friendly warm palette.

spacing.rule: Generous map-safe margins. Floating map controls should sit at least 24pt away from screen edges. Elements within bottom sheets should use md and lg gaps.

do's: Use heavy glassmorphism for floating map controls (FABs, filter pills) to keep the map visible underneath.
Use glass for the top fade under the status bar.
Use a glass header when viewing the active ride details layered over the live map.
dont's: Never blur the bottom sheet background containing critical ride details or QR code scanning surfaces.

screens.name: Live Map (Home)
screens.purpose: A full-bleed map for users to instantly locate and select nearby scooters.

states.loading: Map skeleton or branded spinner overlay on blank surface.
states.empty: Map empty state showing 'No scooters nearby' with an illustration and a 'Notify Me' CTA.
states.error: A toast over the map: 'Unable to connect to location services' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map canvas. Top layer includes a floating user profile/wallet pill (top left) and filter pill (top right). Bottom layer contains a large, primary 'Scan to Ride' CTA floating pill dead center, flanked by a 'Center Location' FAB. Map pins use clustered markers that expand on zoom, displaying battery percent.

screens.name: Scooter Detail Bottom Sheet
screens.purpose: Provides instant context on a tapped scooter so the user can commit to unlocking.

states.loading: Skeleton text blocks for battery and range.
states.empty: Not applicable; only triggered by valid scooter tap.
states.error: Error fetching scooter status with an inline retry icon.

screens.layout: Pops up from the bottom when a map pin is tapped. Shows an image of the scooter, large battery indicator pill (color-coded using success/warning tokens), pricing (e.g., $1 unlock + 0.35/min), and a chunky, tactile 'Slide to Unlock' or 'Unlock Scooter' button at the bottom. The CTA must be anchored.

screens.name: QR Scanner
screens.purpose: Allows users to directly rent a scooter by scanning its handlebar QR code.

states.loading: Overlay spinner while validating the scanned code.
states.empty: Black screen if camera permission denied, prompting to 'Enable Camera in Settings'.
states.error: Flash error message 'Invalid QR code' on screen.

screens.layout: Full screen camera view. 80% screen cutout with a subtle border. Flashlight toggle FAB floating below the cutout. Cancel X button at top left (glass pill).

screens.name: Active Ride
screens.purpose: Extremely legible dashboard displaying ongoing trip metrics while riding.
screens.layout: Map in the background heavily dimmed. A large elevated sheet covers the bottom 40% featuring oversized typography: Live Timer (XX:XX), Distance, and Running Cost. A massive, tactile 'End Ride' button colored in surfaceInverse (Deep Charcoal) at the bottom.

screens.name: Payment & Receipt
screens.purpose: Confirm trip completion, display total cost, and confirm successful payment.

states.error: Payment failed. Please update your payment method.

screens.layout: Centered receipt card over surface background. Shows start/end times, total distance, final cost, and an illustration of the scooter. Primary CTA 'Done' to return to map.

scooter_asset.alt: Isolated electric scooter for vehicle detail screens

qr_placeholder.alt: Graphic depicting scanning a QR code

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful LIGHT (4) rules: chunky components, overlapping rounded forms, pill buttons, and controlled asymmetry for visual interest.

Banned Colors: ALL blues (including navy/indigo) and purples are strictly prohibited. The theme relies on 'Athletic Gold/Ochre' (#F3A712) for brand identity to resonate with the Eagles campus vibe, paired with deep charcoal for text and CTAs.
Map implementation is the hero: ensure map controls (profile, filters, 'Scan to Ride') float over the map using glassmorphism. They should not sit in a rigid header/footer structure.
Always place primary CTAs in the lower 1/3 (thumb zone) inside a safe-area anchored container.
The QR scanner must include permission handling and a clear visual bounding box (cutout).
For the active ride screen, prioritize glanceability. Use the 'displayFontFamily' (Outfit) for the large timer and cost metrics, making them unmissably large.
BLE connection simulation (unlocking) should trigger a haptic pulse and use a tactile 'Slide to Unlock' or chunky pressable button.
All bottom sheets (like the scooter detail) must use @gorhom/bottom-sheet with generous internal padding (xl: 24pt).
